subject: gk
question: In August 2021, the Administrator of Lakshadweep, Praful Khoda Patel, highlighted that __________ style water villas, a project which is a first of its kind, will soon be set up in Lakshadweep, at a cost of 800 crores, in a bid to attract tourists to scenic beauty of the Union Territory
solution:
The correct answer is __**Maldives**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Maldives is renowned for its over-water villas, which are popular among tourists for their luxurious amenities and breathtaking views.
 
• These water villas in the Maldives are often built on stilts over the ocean and offer direct access to the water, making them a unique and attractive accommodation option.
 
• The Maldives has a thriving tourism industry, and the concept of over-water villas has significantly contributed to its appeal as a top travel destination.
 
• By introducing Maldives-style water villas, Lakshadweep aims to replicate this success and boost its own tourism industry.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Lakshadweep**

 
 
• Lakshadweep is a Union Territory of India, consisting of 36 islands located in the Arabian Sea.
 
• It is known for its pristine beaches, clear blue waters, and rich marine life, making it a potential hotspot for tourism.
 
• The introduction of luxury water villas is part of the development plans to enhance the tourism infrastructure in Lakshadweep.
 
• The project aims to attract more tourists by offering world-class accommodation and showcasing the natural beauty of the islands.
 
 
 
• **Tourism in Maldives**
 
 
• The Maldives is one of the world's most popular tourist destinations, attracting visitors with its stunning coral reefs, clear lagoons, and luxurious resorts.
 
• Tourism is the largest economic sector in the Maldives, contributing significantly to its GDP and providing employment opportunities for the local population.
 
• The concept of over-water villas has been a key factor in the Maldives' tourism success, offering a unique and luxurious experience to visitors.
 
• These water villas are equipped with modern amenities and provide unparalleled views of the ocean, enhancing the overall appeal of the destination.
 
 
 
• **Economic Impact of Tourism**
 
 
• Tourism is a major driver of economic growth in many countries, generating revenue, creating jobs, and promoting infrastructure development.
 
• In addition to direct economic benefits, tourism can also lead to the preservation of natural and cultural heritage by providing the financial resources needed for conservation efforts.
 
• Developing luxury accommodations, such as water villas, can help attract high-spending tourists, further boosting the local economy.
 
• However, it is essential to manage tourism sustainably to minimize its environmental impact and ensure long-term benefits for the local community.
